correctness.rationale: For all integers b>=3 the marker-gap and first-0^d1 arguments prove each exact shortest new phrase, including shorter-prefix repetition. The b=2 case is proved by aligning the first 1 and distinguishing the second, with initial phases checked separately. Consecutiveness and unbounded endpoints establish the whole parsing; 115 additional finite phrase checks in check.py independently match the formulas for bases 2..12. Finite tests are not used to justify the universal quantifier.

The 2007 full article was unavailable, and an unindexed equivalent remains a risk.

value.rationale: Determines all phrases of a natural infinite base-parametrized automatic family, including exact leading constants and a sharp b=2 versus b>=3 change in a compression-relevant invariant. This is stronger than a general Theta(log N) deduction and applies to every scale and base rather than an isolated finite cutoff.
